entities.name: Bahar Çağlar Ökten
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bahar Çağlar Ökten is a Turkish retired professional basketball player. She competed at two Summer Olympic Games: the 2012 and 2016. She has been married to the advocate Emin Ökten since 29 August 2020.
